sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Fulfilling mitzvos specifically during the exile, despite their lack of perfection, generates greater power and refines the darkness of exile.

translations.translation: And likewise regarding the fulfillment of the mitzvos specifically during the time of exile,
for although the mitzvos during the exile are not at the ultimate perfection
[In addition to the fact that the main perfection of the performance of the mitzvos will be in the days of Moshiach, as it is written, "And there
(specifically)
we will perform before You... as Your commandments of Your will,"
for this perfection did not exist even during the time of the Temple100,
behold, the mitzvos of the time of exile do not even have the perfection that existed during the time of the Temple101],
nevertheless, through the very contemplation that during the exile perfection is lacking,
through this the performance of the mitzvos is with greater power.
And it is like that which is explained in Tanya102
regarding the superiority of the Baal Teshuvah over the righteous,
that because he was distant from G-dliness, therefore his thirst is more intense,
with a great love from the depths of the heart.
And through this very thing
(that the performance of mitzvos during the exile is with greater power)
they refine the darkness of exile and transform it into holiness,
like that which is explained in Tanya102,
that through teshuvah from great love and thirst, intentional sins are transformed into merits
(that initially they become intentional sins like merits with a "kaf" of comparison,
until they become actual merits).
And this is that the ultimate perfection of the future is brought about
(primarily)
specifically through the fulfillment of the mitzvos during the time of exile103,
and especially through the service of teshuvah,
for the two aspects of the dwelling in the lower realms
(which is the perfection of the future),
a dwelling for His very Essence (Atzmus) and a dwelling in the lower realms,
are brought about
(primarily)
specifically through the fulfillment of the mitzvos during the time of exile,
and especially through the service of teshuvah.
For through the thirst and greater power of the time of exile,
and especially through the cry of teshuvah from the depths of the heart,
they draw down from the aspect of the depth and inwardness of the upper realms,
to Him, to His very Essence (Atzmus),
and through the refinement and transformation of the darkness of exile,
and especially the transformation of intentional sins into merits
(through teshuvah),
they refine and purify even the lowest matters, and they become a dwelling for Him, blessed be He.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The ultimate perfection of the world in the future, surpassing even the revelation at Sinai, will be achieved through our service in exile, transforming darkness into light.

translations.translation: And this is that the ultimate perfection of the world will be specifically in the future,
"These are the generations of Peretz,"
for this perfection is higher than the perfection that existed at the beginning of creation, "the world was created in its fullness,"
and higher even than the perfection of the world that existed at the Giving of the Torah,
although also at the Giving of the Torah the world proclaimed "Anochi,"
"Lo Yihiyeh Lecha"
(which are the entirety of the entire Torah104),
for at the Giving of the Torah this was primarily from the side of the revelation from Above
(that the utterances "Anochi" and "Lo Yihiyeh Lecha" were emitted and heard from all six directions of the world),
as mentioned above,
but in the future this will be from the world itself105,
as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said106
"In the future, if a person goes to gather a fig on Shabbos, it will cry out and say, 'It is Shabbos today...' the stone will scream and say..."
(that this will be from the fig and the stone themselves).
And moreover,
that through our actions and service during the time of exile in the occupation with Torah and fulfillment of mitzvos, through which we also refine the darkness of exile,
and especially through teshuvah, intentional sins become for Him like merits,
through this the purification of the world in the future will be also in the lowest matters,
until even the darkness will be transformed into light.
And this is "These are the generations of Peretz," this is Moshiach, about whom it is said, "The one who breaches goes up before them,"
who will breach all boundaries,
meaning that even the boundaries
(from the side of holiness107)
will be breached.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The service of teshuvah has a specific time from Rosh Chodesh Elul through Yom Kippur, culminating in the absorption of the revelation on Shemini Atzeret, which establishes a dwelling for Him.

translations.translation: And 4)
Now, since in the service of man there must be order,
therefore,
even the service of teshuvah,
although it is above order and gradation,
has a specific time,
in the forty days between Rosh Chodesh Elul and Yom Kippur,
which are the four Yuds of the acronym "Ani L'Dodi V'Dodi Li"108.
For the service of teshuvah is from below upward,
first "Ani L'Dodi" and then "V'Dodi Li."
And although the last ten days of these forty days
(the ten days between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur)
are in the manner of drawing down and revelation from above downward, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said109
on the verse110
"Seek the L-rd when He is to be found, call upon Him when He is near; these are the ten days between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur"
(for "when He is to be found" and "when He is near" is a revelation from above downward),
and as is known111
that in these days there is a drawing near of the Luminary to the spark,
nevertheless, even these days belong to the service of teshuvah from the side of the lower one,
for the drawing down and revelation from above that occurs in these days is brought about through the service and arousal from below of the month of Elul,
that through the service in the first three Yuds
("Ani L'Dodi V'Dodi")
the Yud of the word "Li" is made,
the drawing near of the Luminary to the spark.
And in these ten days there are many ascents,
until the ultimate ascent of Yom Kippur,
and on Yom Kippur itself the ultimate ascent is in the Neilah prayer
(at its conclusion and seal of the day),
and it can be said that in Neilah itself – in the recitation of "Shema Yisrael"
(which is at its conclusion and seal),
and as it is brought in the Shlah that one should intend then to give his soul for the sanctification of G-d's Name, and this intention is considered for him as if he had actually done it
[And perhaps it can be said that it is like the statement of the Baal Shem Tov112
"In the place where a person's thought is, there he is."]
For all this is an ascent from below upward.
And afterwards begins the matter of drawing down from above downward
(through which the intention of "for He created it to be inhabited"113 is completed),

for the beginning of the drawing down is in the four days between Yom Kippur and Sukkos, when all of Israel are occupied with mitzvos, one occupies himself with his sukkah and another with his lulav114,
and afterwards, during the days of Sukkos themselves, through the actual fulfillment of the mitzvah of dwelling in the sukkah and taking the Four Species,
for through the fulfillment of the mitzvah of sukkah the drawing down is in the aspect of makif (encompassing light),
and through taking the Four Species it is drawn into inwardness, "And you shall take for yourselves"115.
And all this must be in the aspect of absorption,
and this
(the absorption)
is accomplished on Shemini Atzeret,
"Atzeret" from the term "absorption."
[For this is also what is written116
"Blow the shofar at the new moon, at the covered time for our festival day,"
and the explanation of this is known,
that what on Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur is in the manner of "bakeseh"
(covered and hidden)
is revealed on "our festival day" on the festival of Sukkos117,
and nevertheless it is said "for our festival day" in the singular
(and not "for our festival days" in the plural),
for the main revelation
(of the matters of Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur)
in the manner of absorption is on Shemini Atzeret,
"for our festival day" in the singular118].
And as is known that on Shemini Atzeret is the union119,
even to the aspect of "and they shall become one flesh"120,
from which is born the offspring of T.U.M.Tz
(the offspring of the righteous are good deeds121)
throughout the entire year,
to make for Him, blessed be He, a dwelling in the lower realms.
And this is also that "Atzeret" is from the term for kingship
(like this122
"he will restrain [ya'atzor] my people"123),
for on Shemini Atzeret a Jew becomes a king and a master over the entire order of the chain of descent,
to make from it a dwelling for Him, blessed be He.
